name: algormortis
source:
The algormortis story centers around Lamira, a faun living alone in a small village. Tired of his own monotonous life, Lamira wishes for something to change, and his wish is granted in the form of Mortrini—a monstrous, zombie-like creature who maims others and uses their remains to repair her constantly decomposing body.

[From [url=https://lovelandisle.itch.io/algormortis]official site[/url]]
translation:
Algormortis的故事以拉米拉为中心，她是一位独自生活在小村庄里的农牧神。厌倦了自己单调的生活，拉米拉希望有所改变，而他的愿望以莫特里尼的形式实现了——莫特里尼是一种可怕的僵尸般的生物，她会残害他人，并用他们的遗体来修复自己不断腐烂的身体。

[来自[url=https://lovelandisle.itch.io/algormortis]官方网站[/url]]
